races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden

runners_data.name: Sunrise Angel
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in five runs but consistently competitive, with a third and runner-up effort among the finishes and previous experience over today's distance. Tops our figures at 64 from stall 10, though a 64-day break clouds the fitness picture.

runners_data.name: Zheleznaya Dama
runners_data.comment: A rapid reappearance just three days on keeps her sharp, and a third three starts back shows definite ability, backed by previous experience over today's distance. The form either side is mixed, including a pulled-up effort, but she is our selection from stall 9.

runners_data.name: Wicklow Gap
runners_data.comment: A fourth three starts back is the form high point and he returns within a fortnight, with previous experience over today's distance from stall 6. Three finishes of ninth in five outings and a stone-cold yard (0 winners from 45) are the main concerns.

runners_data.name: Concaire
runners_data.comment: A clear second two starts back is the standout form line, with previous experience over today's distance from stall 12 in support. Results either side have been modest, including a below-par effort last time, leaving a slightly inconsistent profile at 63 on our figures.

runners_data.name: De Songbird
runners_data.comment: Modest form across her last four starts, with nothing better than sixth, though she has previous experience over today's distance from stall 8. A cold yard (1 winner from 20) and a 40-day break add to the questions here.

runners_data.name: Sayonara
runners_data.comment: A third and fifth among the finishes show he's competitive enough at this level, though two unplaced efforts temper things. A rapid reappearance just three days on and a par speed figure (57) leave him firmly a midfield type on our figures (54).

runners_data.name: Tavarua
runners_data.comment: Modest form on paper, with nothing better than sixth in four runs, but a strong speed figure (70) hints at more ability than that suggests. She has previous experience over today's distance from stall 14, and is rated above her official mark on our figures (59).

runners_data.name: Wingit
runners_data.comment: Two sixth-placed efforts are the best of a modest set of finishes, with two unplaced runs and a ninth also in the mix, though she has previous experience over today's distance from stall 13. A reappearance inside a fortnight keeps her sharp, but the overall picture stays only moderate (58).

runners_data.name: Six Wings
runners_data.comment: Well held throughout her last five starts, with finishes no better than sixth and two unplaced efforts in the mix. Rated below her official mark on our figures (39), the bottom of these despite previous experience over today's distance.

runners_data.name: Stonyfalls
runners_data.comment: A third two starts back is the highlight of mixed recent form, amid a couple of ninths and an unplaced effort. Quick back into action just a day after her last run, with previous experience over today's distance, she rates a workable midfield type (55).

runners_data.name: Garryowen Green
runners_data.comment: Little in the way of form to work with, two ninths among four largely well-held efforts, and rated near the bottom of this field on our figures (43). Previous experience over today's distance from stall 11 is about the only thing in his favour.

runners_data.name: Ramair
runners_data.comment: A third four starts back stands out from an otherwise moderate set of finishes, with previous experience over today's distance from stall 2 in support. A 70-day absence and modest speed figures (52) leave plenty to prove, with only 48 on our figures underlining the task.

runners_data.name: Beau Army
runners_data.comment: A second five starts back is the formline of note in an otherwise mixed set, including two unplaced efforts. Previous experience over today's distance and a fair speed figure (60) offer some encouragement, though the yard is out of form (1 winner from 27).

runners_data.name: Cause I Like You
runners_data.comment: Runner-up last time out, the best of a fairly consistent set with nothing worse than sixth barring one blank effort. A decent speed figure (66) and previous experience over today's distance support a workable case on our figures (52), despite a moderate official mark (42).

runners_data.name: Spent All Me Money
runners_data.comment: Won three starts back and carries 143lb from stall 15 today. Proven over today's distance, this gelding rates 74, third in the field with a useful 69 speed figure - though two blank runs have followed since, the latest 93 days ago.

runners_data.name: San Aer
runners_data.comment: San Aer boasts the field's best figures — rated 87, speed 76 — with a runner-up five starts back and form over today's distance. Winless in his last five starts and fresh from a 64-day break, but nothing else here comes close to these figures.

runners_data.name: Majestic King
runners_data.comment: A win four starts back sandwiched by places either side represents this gelding's peak, but the two most recent runs have both gone unrewarded. Rated 70 (6th of 15, speed 65) from stall 1, he has form over today's distance and is race-fit having run 18 days ago.

runners_data.name: No More Porter
runners_data.comment: Second last time out and rarely too far away, this gelding rates a strong 75 (2nd of 15, speed 76) and has form over today's distance. The stable is out of form (1 winner from 27 runners in the last fortnight), the obvious concern.

runners_data.name: Red Hugh O'Donnell
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced, this gelding won five starts back but has been below that level since, finishing eighth last time. Fit having run 18 days ago, carries 138lb from stall 8, and remains open to improvement with minimal starts to fully judge from.

runners_data.name: Galley Point
runners_data.comment: A close second three starts back is the highlight of this colt's recent form, but results have tailed off either side of that, including a below-par ninth last time. Rated 70 (7th of 15, speed 61), he returns from a lengthy 242-day absence with form over today's distance.

runners_data.name: Little Miss P
runners_data.comment: Without a win in her last five starts and yet to break into the frame, this filly sits near the foot of our figures at 64, 12th in the field. In her favour, she races fresh (13 days), has form over today's distance, and shows a useful 68 speed figure.

runners_data.name: Tofino
runners_data.comment: Runner-up two starts back, this filly's figures (73, 4th of 15, speed 67) make her one of the leading dangers, with recent form over today's distance. The concern is a subsequent decline in form and a stable with no winners from 45 runners in the last fortnight.

runners_data.name: Marambo
runners_data.comment: Modest form figures of 5-4-4 in a short recent sample leave this gelding rated 68 (8th of 15, speed 55), without a win in those three recent starts. He returns from a lengthy 207-day break with prior form over today's distance.

runners_data.name: Usuario Amigo
runners_data.comment: Winless in six recent starts and with a best finish of seventh twice, this gelding is nonetheless fresh having run just 3 days ago. Rated 70 (5th of 15, speed 67) with form over today's distance, though the finishing positions offer only modest encouragement.

runners_data.name: Amemri
runners_data.comment: Rated only 64, second-bottom of the field; this mare's form is mixed — a winner five starts back, a runner-up three starts back, but inconsistent otherwise. She has raced over today's distance before and is race-fit after a 25-day break.

runners_data.name: Elusive Duke
runners_data.comment: Two runner-up efforts in his last five starts show this gelding is competitive without getting his head in front, rated 68 (9th of 15) but boasting a strong 79 speed figure. Fit after a 20-day break with form over today's distance, from stall 9 carrying 132lb.

runners_data.name: Hexagonal
runners_data.comment: A second-placed effort five starts back is the standout in an otherwise modest recent record for this gelding, who was down the field again last time. Rated 68 (10th of 15, speed 70), fresh after an 11-day break, with form over today's distance.

runners_data.name: Mythical Rock
runners_data.comment: Rated 64 (11th of 15) and among the outsiders on our figures; this gelding was a winner five starts back, runner-up two starts back. He has form over today's distance and is race-fit after a 32-day break, from stall 5 under 131lb.

runners_data.name: Mags
runners_data.comment: Unplaced in all four of her recent starts, this mare is hard to fancy on form alone and sits 13th of 15 on our figures at 64. She does have a useful 69 speed figure and form over today's distance, fresh after a 34-day break from stall 4.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap

runners_data.name: Ankara
runners_data.comment: Won her first two starts in this sample but form dipped over the next three, the latest two runs both blank. A 267-day break has followed, though a yard in good form (15 winners from 44 runners in the last fortnight) offers encouragement for this lightly raced, unexposed filly carrying 140lb from stall 4.

runners_data.name: Spanish Temptress
runners_data.comment: Won last time out and rated the best of this field at 90, Spanish Temptress has rarely finished out of the frame, missing the first four only once. Fresh on a 25-day break, her one query is a modest 68 speed figure, but the form makes her the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Diamond Exchange
runners_data.comment: Two wins in her last five starts, the latest three runs back, have Diamond Exchange rated 90 (2nd of 9) with an excellent 83 speed figure. She has form over today's distance and is fresh after 17 days, though the yard is out of form (1 winner from 29 in the last fortnight).

runners_data.name: Saga Gaga
runners_data.comment: In her last two starts, the latest was a win having been seventh before that. Saga Gaga sits seventh of nine on our figures at 80 with a modest 68 speed figure, hard to fully fancy on ability, though that recent success off a 32-day break is a point in her favour.

runners_data.name: Concert Party
runners_data.comment: Back-to-back wins two and three starts back are the highlight for this filly, though the finishing positions either side - a fifth, a fifth, and an unplaced effort last time - are more modest. Rated 82 (5th of 9, speed 65), she returns from an 87-day break carrying 129lb from stall 7.

runners_data.name: Jeaniemacaroney
runners_data.comment: Won last time out having also been runner-up in each of her three prior starts, Jeaniemacaroney rates 89 (3rd of 9, speed 78) and looks a leading threat with form over today's distance. The obvious concern is a lengthy 285-day absence since that success.

runners_data.name: My Girl Grace
runners_data.comment: In her only recent start, My Girl Grace won, leaving little else to judge her on. Rated 79 (8th of 9) with a fair 69 speed figure, fresh after a 40-day break but unexposed at this level.

runners_data.name: So Must I
runners_data.comment: A win four starts back is the highlight of a mixed campaign for So Must I, otherwise no better than fourth in that span. Rated 86 (4th of 9, speed 66) with form over today's distance and backed by a yard in good form (15 from 44 last fortnight), the main task is rediscovering that best level after a 40-day break.

runners_data.name: Speckled Meadow
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts and yet to finish inside the frame, this mare nonetheless carries a strong speed figure of 80 and is rated 81 (6th of 9). Fresh after a 33-day break with form over today's distance, though the finishing positions offer little encouragement.

runners_data.name: Tribal Star
runners_data.comment: Yet to score in six starts this term but rarely far away, with two thirds and two fourths among recent finishes and previous experience over today's trip. Tops our figures on 95, though the stable is out of form (1 from 27).

runners_data.name: Persian Bliss
runners_data.comment: One win and two runner-up efforts in the last five starts, including a placed effort last time out, show durable, competitive form, with previous experience over today's trip. A 71-day layoff is the obvious question, but the figures (90) put him firmly among the leading dangers.

runners_data.name: Individualism
runners_data.comment: A winner five starts back but has since been below that level, finishing seventh last time out. A runner-up effort two starts back keeps him on the fringes of contention here, rated 84 on our figures.

runners_data.name: Satono Chevalier
runners_data.comment: Won last time out and twice more in the past six starts, though a below-par eighth two runs back shows he can find one below his best. Modest speed figures (67), and previous form over today's distance, leave a workable if inconsistent profile.

runners_data.name: Sign From Above
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in five outings this term, with a third his best effort, though finishes either side have been mixed, last time out included. A big speed figure (85) and previous experience over today's trip keep him of interest despite the 50-day gap.

runners_data.name: Carthusian
runners_data.comment: Well held throughout his last five starts, with three sevenths among them, and the yard is out of form (1 winner from 29). A quick reappearance and a decent speed figure (81) are about the only things in his favour.

runners_data.name: Gaoth Chuil
runners_data.comment: Won last time out, a performance that leaves her rated well above her official mark on our figures (90). The three runs before that were modest — no better than fourth — but she does have previous experience over today's distance.

runners_data.name: Harry's Legacy
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in five runs but rarely too far away, with a second and third among the finishes either side of below-par efforts. Bottom of these on our figures (75), though he does have previous experience over today's distance.
